per_depth.common_affordance: Direct presentation of the problem as finding a satisfying assignment for clauses with exactly two signed boolean literals (2-SAT)
The direct presentation of constraints as standard 2-CNF disjunctive clauses with signed integer literals representing positive and negative states.
The direct definition of relay violation as simultaneously omitting both target modes, trivially simplifying via de Morgan's laws to standard 2-SAT CNF clause (l1 OR l2).
